verdict.rationale: Dagster's Sensors are explicitly designed to take action in response to events occurring internally or in external systems, and Declarative Automation lets users define conditions that automatically launch asset executions based on status/dependency changes, directly matching the event-triggered-rules story. Schedules complement this for time-based triggers, and changelog entries show ongoing refinement of automation condition semantics. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of sensor reliability at scale, explicit examples of AI-agent-authored sensors/rules.
